The situation gets even more complicated when you consider the fees, speed, and automation of these services. But there's a better way to build your digital commerce infrastructure, one that gives you complete ownership and control over your payments, customers, and art. The conventional options for selling digital art, like Stripe and Gumroad, promise ease of use and a wide range of features. However, when you're in a restricted country, these services become unavailable or severely limited. This means you're left with a watered-down version of their offering, with features missing or disabled. In contrast, a sovereign commerce stack, like the one offered by COREMERCH, gives you complete ownership and control over your payments, customers, and art. With a sovereign stack, you can collect payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, store customer data securely, and deliver your art directly to your customers without relying on third-party services.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The conventional options for selling digital art, like Stripe and Gumroad, often have a blanket ban on restricted countries. This means that even if you have a valid business or individual account, you'll still be locked out of their services. In contrast, a sovereign commerce stack is designed to be accessible from anywhere in the world, even in restricted countries. With a sovereign stack, you can collect payments, store customer data, and deliver your art without being tied to a specific platform or service.

In contrast, a sovereign commerce stack, like the one offered by COREMERCH, has a low fee structure and fast payment processing. With a sovereign stack, you can collect payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, store customer data securely, and deliver your art directly to your customers without relying on third-party services.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The conventional options for selling digital art, like Stripe and Gumroad, often require you to rely on their services for delivery and automation. This means that you're tied to their platform and subject to their rules and regulations. In contrast, a sovereign commerce stack gives you complete ownership and control over your payments, customers, and art. With a sovereign stack, you can automate delivery, store customer data securely, and collect payments in your preferred cryptocurrency without relying on third-party services.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between a conventional option and a sovereign commerce stack depends on your specific situation. If you're in a restricted country and need a low-cost, high-speed payment solution, a sovereign stack may be the better choice. However, if you're willing to rely on a specific platform or service, and don't mind the fees and restrictions, a conventional option may be sufficient.
